'''Zone 54g''' was a region of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]]. The company [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]] operated an [[Tor-Ro-Bo Processing Center 879|ore processing facility]] on an island that was situated in Zone54g.<ref name="Imminent Impact" />
